notes.title: Evasilix Turns 1 Year Old!
notes.notes:
Attention to all robots!

Today we are celebrating the [b]1st anniversary of Evasilix[/b]! We are proud of what we've accomplished for our first game, especially our 25 levels filled with unique ideas to challenge you.

We are already working hard on a new title with all the experience gained from making Evasilix. This new game will be very different from our first one, but we hope you will like it too!

To celebrate this first year, Evasilix is [b]now on discount[/b] for the next few days for all newcomers!

Thank you for this first year, see you soon,

The Obstenatis Team

notes.title: Fancy voting for us in "Best Game You Suck At" category for the Steam Awards?

Hi everyone,

We hope everyone likes the new features of the V1.0.1.1 update.

We'd just like to ask if you could take a minute to vote for us in the Steam Awards in the "Best Game You Suck At" category.

Furthermore, we are currently working hard on new updates, and we'll keep you posted!

Have a nice week all!

Phil Carnby
